title: Mapping Stakeholder Needs to Multi-Sided Fairness in Candidate Recommendation for Algorithmic Hiring
reasoning: The paper focuses on the sociotechnical aspects of AI fairness and bias mitigation in the context of recruitment and hiring. While fairness is an ethical principle, the study is a user-centric research paper mapping stakeholder needs to algorithmic metrics rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, theology, or general moral/ethical systems.
